params.description:
Unique numeric identifier of the work order.
***Note:*** You need to have access to the WO location per your user settings.

params.name: paging
params.description:
Page numbering to display work order notes.
             • The format is **Page number:Page size**, for example, **1:10**, meaning the 1st page with 10 notes displayed. To view the second page, change the entry to **2:10**.
             • When the field is left empty, you get 10 notes per page with the latest note at the top.
             • To get all WO notes, ensure you specify a large number as the **Page size** that will cover all the notes, for example, **1:9999**.

items.docs:
Returns notes and attachments associated with the specified work order. Notes are sorted in descending order by creation date.
Learn more about work order notes in [SCU](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/x/4oPNKQ).
